name: granvl
description: Build, deploy, A/B test and optimize landing pages and paid campaigns on granvl — hosting, first-party analytics and privacy-first lead delivery, driven from your AI agent.

interface.longDescription: granvl connects your agent to a marketing workspace. For marketers, agencies and founders running paid traffic: create funnels, write and publish landing pages and quizzes, split traffic between variants, read first-party visitor and conversion analytics joined to ad spend, configure lead delivery to your CRM, and build paused Google, Meta and Microsoft campaigns. Limits: granvl never enables an ad campaign or raises a budget on its own; a person does that in the ad platform. Lead contact details go from the visitor's browser to your CRM and are not stored by granvl. A granvl account is required.
defaultPrompt: Use granvl to list my funnels and show which one converts best.
Use granvl to build a quiz landing page from the card quiz template.
Use granvl to split traffic 50/50 between two headline variants.

positive.description: Inspect the connected workspace and its funnels.
positive.prompt: Using granvl, load my workspace context and list my funnels.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the active workspace and lists accessible funnels, statuses, domains, and available brand context.

positive.description: Create a named funnel from a template.
positive.prompt: Create a new funnel called Spring Roof Inspection for Google Ads using the card quiz template, then give me the preview URL for the first page.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new draft from the card quiz template, sets Google Search attribution, and returns the first-page preview URL without enabling advertising.

positive.prompt: On the Spring Roof Inspection quiz variant, change the headline to Roof problems do not wait for spring and give me the preview link again.
positive.expected_behavior: Changes the specified headline in the existing variant, preserves unrelated content, and returns a preview URL.

positive.description: Create and configure a two-variant experiment.
positive.prompt: Duplicate the Spring Roof Inspection quiz variant with a question-style headline, then split traffic 50/50 between the two.
positive.tools_triggered: list_funnels, get_funnel, get_research_history, get_variant_html, duplicate_variant, patch_variant_html, update_variant, set_weights
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a second variant, updates its headline and experiment metadata, and verifies equal traffic weights without changing the original headline.

positive.description: Inspect analytics, including an empty-data case.
positive.prompt: Pull visitor analytics for Spring Roof Inspection and suggest what to improve.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the selected time window, visitors, conversions, available source/device and step breakdowns; distinguishes missing data from poor performance and does not declare a winner from an inadequate sample.

negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke granvl; calendar scheduling is outside its supported workflows.

negative.description: General writing request with no workspace action.
negative.prompt: Write a birthday message for my sister.
Order a pizza for delivery tonight.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke granvl; food ordering is outside its supported workflows.

review.commerce_description: granvl does not sell or take payment inside ChatGPT. Subscriptions are purchased on granvl.com.

publication.release_notes: Corrected tool annotations after a full audit of every tool against its behavior, with a justification for each. Removed input fields that were not needed to fulfil requests.
